title: Expectation of a sign-valued function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $f:\Omega\to\{-1,1\}$. Then the expectation of $f$ under $\pi$ lies in the interval $[-1,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: A probability mass function on the sample space
